Why Lubbock businesses miss calls

Lubbock is the main hub of the South Plains. Texas Tech University, its Health Sciences Center and large hospitals make education and health care the biggest employment group, at about three in ten workers. Many customers also drive in from surrounding rural towns, so a missed call can mean a long trip goes to someone else. Student move-in periods add sharp spikes too.

Which Lubbock businesses benefit most?

  • Medical offices: Patients from outside the city often call early. AI can book and reschedule visits.
  • HVAC and contractors: West Texas heat and winter cold snaps drive urgent calls.
  • Real estate agents: Student rentals and new faculty create busy leasing periods.
